description: A data-driven, stateless/controlled tree component. The consuming application owns the `nodes` data (the single source of truth) and the controlled `selectedNodeId` / `expandedNodeIds` state. The component renders the tree and emits `nodeSelect` / `nodeExpandChange`; the application decides whether to apply the change and passes the updated state back in.

properties.name: allowDragDrop
properties.description: Enables drag-and-drop reordering and reparenting via a per-row drag handle (shown on hover). After a successful drop the component emits `nodeMove` on `dragend`; the application applies it (e.g. via `moveNodeRelative`) and passes updated `nodes` back in.

properties.name: bordered
properties.description: Indicates that the content tree should have a border.

properties.name: customClass
properties.description: Custom CSS class to apply to the host element.

properties.name: checkedNodeIds
properties.description: The ids of the checked leaf nodes (multi-select). Controlled by the consuming application.

properties.name: editingNodeId
properties.description: The id of the node currently rendered as an inline editable input. Controlled by the consuming application (typically set in response to `nodeEdit`, `nodeAdd`, or `nodeDuplicate`).

properties.name: expandedNodeIds
properties.description: The ids of the currently expanded nodes. Controlled by the consuming application.

properties.name: filter
properties.description: When set, only nodes whose label matches (and their ancestors) are shown. Matching is a case-insensitive substring; matched parents reveal their full subtree. When `searchable` is enabled, this only seeds the built-in search box's initial value.

properties.name: nodes
properties.description: The tree data. The single source of truth, owned by the consuming application.

properties.name: searchable
properties.description: Shows a built-in search box above the tree that filters nodes internally (self-managed). When enabled, the search box owns the active filter and the `filter` prop is used only to seed its initial value.

properties.name: selectedNodeId
properties.description: The id of the currently selected (active) node. Controlled by the consuming application.

properties.name: selectionMode
properties.description: The selection mode of the content tree.

properties.name: size
properties.description: The size of the content tree items.

properties.name: toolbar
properties.description: Configures the optional toolbar rendered above the tree. When set, a toolbar is shown with the enabled controls: an expand-all / collapse-all toggle and a delete button (enabled only when nodes are checked in multi-select).

events.name: nodeSelect
events.description: Event emitted when a node is selected. The consuming application should update `selectedNodeId`.

events.name: nodeExpandChange
events.description: Event emitted when a node's expansion is toggled. The consuming application should update `expandedNodeIds`.

events.name: nodeCheckChange
events.description: Event emitted when a checkbox is toggled (multi-select). The consuming application should update `checkedNodeIds`.

events.name: nodeEdit
events.description: Event emitted when "Edit name" is chosen. The app should set `editingNodeId` to this id.

events.name: nodeDuplicate
events.description: Event emitted when "Duplicate" is chosen. The app should clone the node below it and set `editingNodeId` to the new id.

events.name: nodeAdd
events.description: Event emitted when "Add New Above/Below" or "Add Child Node" is chosen. The app should insert a node at the requested position and set `editingNodeId` to the new id.

events.name: nodeDelete
events.description: Event emitted after the user confirms deletion. The app should remove the node from `nodes`.

events.name: nodeRename
events.description: Event emitted when an inline edit is committed with an effective label change (via Enter or losing focus). The app should apply the new label and clear `editingNodeId`.

events.name: nodeEditCancel
events.description: Event emitted when an inline edit ends without an effective change — via Escape, or Enter/blur while the draft matches the original label. The app should clear `editingNodeId` (and discard a freshly added node if its name is still empty).

events.name: nodeMove
events.description: Event emitted after a successful drag-and-drop, once the gesture ends (`dragend`). Emitting on `dragend` (not `drop`) keeps the drag source in the DOM until the browser finishes the gesture, so applying the move (e.g. via `moveNodeRelative`) cannot tear down the handle mid-drag. `position` is relative to `targetId`: `before`/`after` reorder among the target's siblings; `inside` nests the node as the target's first child.

events.name: nodeLoadChildren
events.description: Event emitted the first time a lazy node (`hasChildren: true` with no `children` yet) is expanded. The app should fetch the node's children and assign them to `nodes` (use `[]` when there are none); the component shows a spinner until `children` is defined.

events.name: expandAllChange
events.description: Event emitted when the toolbar's expand-all / collapse-all toggle is clicked. The app should set `expandedNodeIds` to every expandable id (e.g. via `getExpandableNodeIds`) when `expanded` is `true`, or to `[]` when `false`.

events.name: nodesDelete
events.description: Event emitted when the toolbar's delete button is confirmed. `ids` are the top-most checked nodes; the app should remove them (e.g. via `deleteNodes`).

events.name: nodeVisibilityChange
events.description: Event emitted when a node's visibility (eye) toggle is clicked. `disabled` is the new state. The app should update the node's own `disabled` state (e.g. via `setNodeDisabled`); descendants become effectively disabled via ancestor inheritance.

examples.basic:
<modus-wc-content-tree
      ${ref((el) => {
        treeEl = (el as ContentTreeElement) ?? undefined;
        sync();
      })}
      aria-label="Content tree"
      ?bordered=${args.bordered}
      custom-class=${ifDefined(args['custom-class'])}
      selection-mode=${ifDefined(args['selection-mode'])}
      size=${ifDefined(args.size)}
      @nodeSelect=${handleSelect}
      @nodeExpandChange=${handleExpandChange}
    ></modus-wc-content-tree>
